༄༅/ /ja mchod gtsug gi nor bu bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ja mchod gtsug gi nor bu bzhugs so//

rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu lhag pa'i lha// 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog gi zhing khams 'dir| |bza' btung bdud rtsi'i btung ba kun gyi mchog /margad 'dab ldan rtsa ba sdong bur bcas// 'bras bu rnam par rgyal ba'i sman lta bu/ /sum rtsen bdud rtsi'i ro yang zil gnon pa'i// kha dog bzang zhing dri ngad stong khams khyab/ /ro drug nus brgyad yon tan bcu bdun rdzogs// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun sel bar byed/ /de ltar btung ba'i mchog gyur ja yi dngos/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por mngon sprul nas| |snang stong dbyer med gus pas 'bul ba ni// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa mchod par bgyi// stong dang rtsa gnyis sangs rgyas mchod par bgyi// byang sems nyan rang tshogs rnams mchod par bgyi// bka' brgyud gser gyi phreng ba mchod par bgyi| |'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mchod par bgyi// mi pham dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen mchod par bgyi// bshad sgrub rig smra'i brgyud pa mchod par bgyi// so thar sems bskyed brgyud pa mchod par bgyi// bka' gter rig 'dzin brgyud pa mchod par bgyi// rgyud bzhi'i yi dam lha tshogs mchod par bgyi// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral mchod par bgyi// bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma mchod par bgyi// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung mchod par bgyi// bka' sdod dam can gter srung mchod par bgyi// mgon skyabs pha mes brgyud srung mchod par bgyi// de ltar ro brgya bdud rtsi phul ba'i mthus// thub bstan phyogs brgyar dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// sgrub brgyud gtsug rgyan rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i// bstan pa 'khor lo bzhi yis spel ba dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /dge 'dun bslab gsum chos bcur brtson pa dang*// 'gro rnams longs spyod rdzogs ldan dus lta bur// mi mthun phyogs kun nye bar zhi nas kyang*// khyab bdag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog

/rang rig rang gsal shel dkar me long ngogs// 'khor 'das ri mor bkra ba snang stong tsam// zung 'jug chu zla lta bur 'dzin med kyis/ /gnyis med chos sku'i ngang du grol gyur cig /bai ḍūr sa gzhir lha dbang gzugs brnyan ltar// 'gro sems snang ngor thub pa'i snang brnyan shar// rang rang mos pa'i gang 'dul cho 'phrul gyis/ /smin grol nges pa'i rnam thar ston gyur cig /legs bshad mdangs ris bkra ba lung rigs gos/ /rnam dpyod bslab gsum yu bas legs bteg cing*/ /nges don bsgom bya'i tog gis rab mdzes pas/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan phyogs brgyar sgreng bar shog /ces pa'ang rang gzhan gyi chos spyod bya ba'i yan lag tu/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas dkar seng khri sgar du bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
